name: Solid Masjid
summary: A bold ivory mosque grows from one clean foundation, with a warm cap on its slender minaret.
why: The dome flows directly into the hall; the minaret joins the same body and baseline. The dome and pointed doorway both use x=58 as their centerline. A slightly taller dome balances the narrow tower on the left.
risk: This is deliberately simple and familiar; its character comes from its proportions and generous doorway rather than ornament.
sub1: Dome, hall, and tower belong together
sub2: One clear opening for calm and welcome
reasonToChoose: You want the clearest, most direct mosque silhouette.
